name: abap-config-mcp
description: ABAP development over ADT and SPRO/IMG customizing with governed transports, for SAP NetWeaver and S/4HANA.
long_description: Connects Claude to your SAP system through the ABAP Development Tools (ADT) REST API. Search, read, write, activate, ATC, unit tests, debugging, transports, where-used, ST22 dumps and table queries — plus an in-system customizing engine that drives the SM30/SM34 maintenance runtime, so configuration changes get FK checks, change documents and transport recording like a manual SPRO change. Every action runs as the SAP user you configure; intended for DEV and UAT, read-only on Production (set Max risk tier to 0).

sap_url.title: SAP URL
sap_url.description: ADT base URL, e.g. https://sapdev.example.com:44300 (leave empty when using a connections.json file)

sap_user.title: SAP user
sap_user.description: SAP logon user for this system

sap_id.title: System id
sap_id.description: Short name Claude uses for this system (connectionId)

config_file.title: connections.json (several systems)
config_file.description: Optional. A connections.json with one or more systems; when set, the single-system fields above are ignored.
